update-restart: System: restart the server to apply staged updates
world-scan: System: survey the whole loaded world into a coarse heightmap for the world model/map (plus a voxel mode for the console 3D map)
list-entities-region: List all living/mannequin entities (name, type, uuid, position) within a bounding box in a world, for diagnosing untracked/orphan entities not tagged with npc_id.
build-structure: System: build a furnished building (walls, roof, door, windows, role-appropriate interior)
place-structure: System: place a vanilla Minecraft structure template (village houses, smithies, libraries, town centres)
mine: NPC shaft mining; walks down the stair it cuts (the one route allowed below ground).
craft: Craft from a stockpile chest using the live vanilla recipe table. Never consumes ingredients when the result cannot fit. Actions: make, options.
smelt: Smelt stockpile materials with vanilla furnace recipes, burning the least wasteful fuel. Needs a furnace within 2 blocks of the chest.
store: Read a stockpile chest, place a stocked block into the world (action=place), or move surplus into an overflow warehouse chest (action=spill).
industry: Autonomous settlement economy: reads the stockpile each beat and takes the next rung (fell timber, craft, place workshop blocks, smelt, mine), hauling surplus to a warehouse instead of stalling.
presence: Keeps exactly the chunks NPCs stand in loaded and sends the rest home, with a sweep of grace so ground in active use is not churned.
groundskeeper: Food-supply fixes: farmers must be reachable, the buried can dig all the way out, seed pulls hardest.
forester: Walks to its work on foot via the navigator - no teleporting.
forage: Foraging on foot that hunts: sights game up to 72 blocks off, walks to it, and always brings something back from a herd it reaches.
hunger: NPC hunger: fed level drains, tops up from the line store, and starves lethally when empty. Automatically sends a line's forager out when its store runs dry.
roster: Writes what each NPC is doing onto its ledger record, distinguishing a circuit paused for work from one genuinely stuck.
shelter: Walks to its work on foot via the navigator - no teleporting.
pursuits: Needs-and-personality utility chooser; leaves reserved tradespeople to their own work.
navigate: Player-rules walking: surface-biased A*, settles and falls每 step so nobody hangs in the air.
reclaim: Any Ancient restores the dead by walking to a memorial head; the restored are marked living in the ledger so the map shows them back.
needs: The eight drives per NPC: fatigue, purpose and curiosity accumulate; safety, shelter, belonging and wealth are read from the world each beat. Writes them to the ledger.
farm: A field worked forever by a farmer who stays with it - a crop only ripens in a chunk somebody is standing in.
people: Every NPC is a player: hp, hunger, inventory, abilities, skills earned by doing, three needs, jobs chosen by skill, dynamic trade.
tablist: Every living person appears in the tab list, sent as the real player-info packet.
